title: TraceQA run folder
description: The files one run writes. Layout: run.json (RunManifest), events.jsonl (one Event per line), and one folder per browser and viewport holding components.json (ComponentsFile) and, when pictures were asked for, page.png and crops/.

RunManifest.description: run.json. Written at the start and rewritten at the end.

dir.description: Folder name inside the run folder, for example firefox-1280x800.

error.description: Why this target failed, when it did.

Timings.description: Where the time of one target went, in milliseconds. The parts do not add up to durationMs exactly: grouping and writing files are not listed.

openMs.description: Starting the driver if needed, and opening the browser.

loadMs.description: Loading the page and waiting for it to settle, including any settle time asked for.

readMs.description: Running the collector, over all the times it ran.

scrollMs.description: Scrolling and waiting for the page to settle after each scroll.

cropMs.description: Cutting the crops out of the screenshots.

screens.description: How many screens the page was read in.

Event.description: One line of events.jsonl. The same object is sent live to the caller.

seq.description: Starts at 0 and increases by 1 within a run.

type.description: Known values: run.started, target.started, page.opened, elements.collected, page.scrolled, components.grouped, crop.saved, warning, target.retried, target.finished, run.finished, error.

target.description: The target folder name this event belongs to, when it belongs to one.

data.description: Extra fields that depend on the event type.

ComponentsFile.description: components.json: every interactive component found on one page, in one browser, at one viewport.

fingerprintVersion.description: Version of the recipe that produced the component ids. Ids from different versions must not be compared.

Component.description: One kind of interactive element. Repeated copies are instances of the same component.

id.description: The fingerprint: 'c_' followed by 12 hex characters. See spec/fingerprint.md.

name.description: Accessible name. When nameIsTemplate is true the instances have different names and this is '*'.

path.description: Readable structural path, for example 'main > list "Products" > listitem'.

crop.description: Path of a screenshot crop of the component, relative to this file. It is taken from the screen that showed the most of the component while the page was scrolled through. Absent when it never appeared.

Instance.description: One actual element on the page.

key.description: The component id, a colon, and the instance's position in document order.
